overall: AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: no Board or Committee meeting convened on September 22, 2011, and no evidence the September 28, 2011 Committee meeting was held at a non-ADA-compliant site. Matter closed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board's September 22, 2011 gathering at a private residence was held at a location not ADA compliant.
allegations.key_passage: Thus, because only one member of the Board attended the September 22, 2011 gathering, no meeting of the Board occurred on that date, despite the fact that notice was posted for a Board meeting that evening.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee also held a meeting at a non-ADA-compliant location on September 22, 2011.
allegations.key_passage: It therefore appears that a meeting of the Committee also did not take place on that date, because there was no deliberation by the Committee's members.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee's September 28, 2011 meeting at a nursery school building was held at a location that was not ADA compliant.
allegations.key_passage: We credit Town Counsel's response and the School's claims, and find no evidence that the Committee violated the Open Meeting Law by holding a meeting on September 28, 2011 at a location that was not ADA compliant.
